title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Entrusting High People's Courts with Service of Documents to Parties Regarding Prepayment of Appellate Case Acceptance Fees and Other Related Matters
keywords_en: Serving a party with the prepayment of appeal case fee
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Entrusting High People's Courts to Serve Documents Concerning Prepayment of Appeal Case Acceptance Fees and Other Matters to the Parties

Fa [2004] No. 222

To: High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In order to improve the efficiency of filing of second-instance civil and administrative cases in the Supreme People's Court, protect the litigation rights of the parties, and facilitate the parties' litigation, the Supreme People's Court implements a system whereby High People's Courts are entrusted to serve the "Notice on Matters Concerning the Filing of an Appeal and Prepayment of Appeal Case Acceptance Fees" to the parties. The specific notice is as follows:

Article 1: The High People's Court shall, at the same time as serving the first-instance judgment documents on the parties, serve the "Notice on Matters Concerning the Filing of an Appeal and Prepayment of Appeal Case Acceptance Fees and Other Matters."

Article 2: If, after receiving the "Notice on Matters Concerning the Filing of an Appeal and Prepayment of Appeal Case Acceptance Fees and Other Matters," a party fails to prepay the appeal case acceptance fee within the prescribed time limit for payment, and also fails to file an application for deferment, reduction, or exemption of the appeal case acceptance fee, the High People's Court shall submit the appeal petition, the certificate of service, the first-instance judgment documents, and other relevant materials to the Filing Division of the Supreme People's Court.

Article 3: If, after receiving the "Notice on Matters Concerning the Filing of an Appeal and Prepayment of Appeal Case Acceptance Fees and Other Matters," a party files an application for deferment, reduction, or exemption of the appeal case acceptance fee, together with relevant supporting documents, with the High People's Court that rendered the first-instance judgment within the prescribed time limit, the High People's Court shall submit the application together with the entire case file to the Filing Division of the Supreme People's Court.

Article 4: The case file materials for appeal cases submitted by the High People's Court shall comply with the relevant provisions of the "Rules on Filing Work of the Supreme People's Court" and the "Notice on Strictly Implementing the 'Rules on Filing Work of the Supreme People's Court'" issued by the Filing Division of the Supreme People's Court.

The case file materials submitted by the High People's Court shall be accompanied by the appeal petition, the certificate of service or postal receipt for the duplicate of the appeal petition, five copies of the first-instance judgment documents, and the certificate of service or postal receipt indicating that each party has signed for receipt of the "Notice on Matters Concerning the Filing of an Appeal and Prepayment of Appeal Case Acceptance Fees and Other Matters."

Article 5: If the case file materials submitted by the High People's Court do not comply with the provisions of Article 4 of this Notice, and the Filing Division of the Supreme People's Court notifies the High People's Court to supplement and submit the materials, and the High People's Court fails to do so within ten days after receiving the notice, the Filing Division of the Supreme People's Court shall return all the case file materials to the High People's Court.

Article 6: If a party submits the appeal petition directly to the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Court shall affix a receipt stamp on the appeal petition and transfer the appeal petition to the relevant High People's Court for review and handling by means of a sample letter. The date of appeal by the party shall be the date of receipt by the Supreme People's Court.

Article 7: This Notice shall take effect as of January 1, 2005.

October 25, 2004

Note:

The Annexes "Notice on Matters Concerning the Filing of an Appeal and Prepayment of Appeal Case Litigation Fees and Other Matters," seal impression, and "Sample Letter" are omitted.
